assets.world-map: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: actual top-down/isometric pixel game world map, landscape 4:3, for clickable travel. Original detailed cozy fantasy pixel art, not a side-scrolling scene. An explorable continent with seven clearly distinct biomes linked by winding paths, bridges and boats. Landmark centers in canvas percentages: meadow village and cafe (18,27), leafy timber forest (43,20), mysterious purple glowing secret forest (66,20), coastal harbor with lighthouse (86,45), golden desert oasis with cactus and mineral rocks (65,73), personal farmhouse and crop fields (18,68), colorful market village (40,49). Rivers, mountains, forest clearings and clouds between destinations. Clearly distinguish the sea, forests, desert and farm at a glance. Soft dreamy sage lavender peach gold palette, crisp pixels, no characters. No labels, words, numbers, icons, logos or UI, because HTML will add accessible travel labels. Full map visible, no cropped islands.
